b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the result to a
file or to standard output.

## Usage

```
python -m app.cli URL [options]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download (positional argument, required) |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

### Positional arguments

- `url` \xe2\x80\x94 what to download

### Optional arguments

- `-o`, `--output` \xe2\x80\x94 file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet` \xe2\x80\x94 no progress output
'
